scope: frozen comparison A already-failed candidates only

recommendations.condition: Only normalize when all options match an exact statement-set grammar and before/after parsed letter sets are identical.
recommendations.invariant: Preserve option order, key, stem, explanation, assumptions, source refs, and evidence; do not relax CUET gates.
recommendations.status: recommend test-first; no implementation or savings forecast

recommendations.condition: If no passage text is available, do not let standalone repair switch to passage route; locally reject/quarantine before another evaluation.
recommendations.status: recommend contract review and tests; no implementation or savings forecast

limitations: Observed failure-set costs only; not a yield, savings, or future-cost forecast.
Evaluation receipt stage blind_solution is transport-level and does not distinguish logical evaluation checks.
Receipts lack stop reasons, so 6500-output records are a retry diagnostic lead only.
Source excerpt size is descriptive and does not justify evidence trimming.
